# Thumbnailer

An HTTP service that accepts a picture and returns three resized variants.
Decoding runs in a worker process so a malformed file cannot take the API down.

Run `npm test` before pushing.

history.task: Answer with 415 when the posted body is not a picture at all
history.summary: The endpoint now checks the declared content type first and answers 415 for anything that is not a picture, instead of failing deep inside the decoder.

history.task: Keep resized variants on disk so a repeat request is free
history.summary: Resized variants are cached on disk under a content hash, so a repeat request for the same picture skips decoding entirely.

tests.summary: cache hit and miss paths both pass

history.task: Work out where the resident memory spike comes from on a busy afternoon
history.summary: Traced the resident memory spike to concurrent decoding of very large pictures. Recorded the measurements but did not change the guard, because the right ceiling was still under discussion.

history.task: Stop the resize worker from being killed while decoding an oversized picture
history.summary: Tightened the guard in src/thumbnails/limits.ts so the service rejects uploads larger than 8 MB before anything is decoded, which is what stopped the resize worker from being killed under load.
decisions: The size guard runs before decoding, never after: a picture that is refused must never reach the decoder

tests.summary: guard refuses an oversized body and accepts one exactly at the ceiling

history.task: Write down which variant widths the service hands back
history.summary: Listed the three variant widths in the readme so callers stop asking which sizes exist.

# Thumbnailer

An HTTP service that accepts a picture and returns three resized variants.
Decoding runs in a worker process so a malformed file cannot take the API down.

## Variants

The service returns widths of 64, 256, and 1024 pixels, skipping any variant
wider than the original.

Run `npm test` before pushing.

history.task: Add an end to end check that walks a sample picture through the whole pipeline
history.summary: Added an end to end check that posts a sample picture and asserts three variants come back with the right widths.

tests.summary: three variants returned with the expected widths

history.task: Widen the worker pool for the nightly re-render
history.summary: Widened the nightly re-render pool from two workers to five after the cache landed; the run finishes inside its window again.

query: How large a picture may a caller post to the resize endpoint today?
